results.title: Mumbai: Erratic BEST Route 111 Frequency Leaves Hundreds Of CSMT-Nariman Point Commuters Struggling
results.description: Office-goers travelling between CSMT and Nariman Point are facing daily waits of 20-25 minutes due to the reduced frequency of BEST Route 111, commuters said. Passengers claimed delays leave them reaching CSMT late and missing local trains. Staff reportedly said only two buses operate in each direction. Commuters have urged BEST to restore frequency during peak hours.

results.title: US ambassador to Israel denounces settler siege on Palestinians as 'terror'
results.description: The U.S. ambassador to Israel, a staunch supporter of West Bank settlements, on Thursday denounced as "terror" a siege by settlers against Palestinians that drew an unsuccessful intervention by the army. Settlers near Nablus since Sunday have blockaded Palestinian homes, including one owned by a U.S. citizen, with residents saying they have been cut off from food and other supplies.
